what: Salesforce sells cloud software for managing customer relationships: sales, customer service, marketing and commerce, plus Slack, Tableau and its Agentforce AI agents.
money: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Platform, Marketing and Commerce, Data
moat: The market leader in CRM, with customer data and workflows that are costly to move elsewhere.
risks: AI changing how software is priced per user
opportunities: Analysts see about 52% upside from current levels
Gross margin of 78% with very high subscription renewal rates
Its AI agent products are a new revenue line priced on top of existing seats
watch: Current remaining performance obligations and operating margin.
